text.en:
Organization. There is hereby created in the DOF the
CPRO, which shall be responsible for reviewing the customs administration
policies, rules and procedures, and thereafter providing sound
recommendations for the improvement of the same.
The CPRO shall be under the direct supervision and control of the DOF
Secretary, who may designate a subordinate official with the rank of
Undersecretary to oversee the operations of the CPRO.

Powers and Functions. The PRO shall have the
following powers and functions:
Review and evaluate the provisions of existing rules, executive
issuances, rules and regulations on tariff and customs, as well as
international commitments of the Philippine Government on
customs matters, and recommended measures to update,
rationalize and improve current policies and practices with the end
Simplifying customs procedures while
harmonization with internationally-accepted
administration practices and processes;
Improving efficiency in the conduct and delivery of customs
Ensuring proper collection, monitoring and storage of data,
documents and records, which shall be accessible and
readily available upon demand;
Modernizing the systems and policies of the BOC to
strengthen its capabilities in facing new challenges and
opportunities;
Promoting the seamless flow of goods while protecting
local industries;
Maintaining transparency, preventing corruption, and
safeguarding integrity in customs administration; and
Maximizing BOC's revenue collection.

Conduct research on modern regulatory practices on customs and
tariff, and determine their applicability to the Philippine setting;
Draft the customs reform bills and work closely with the
appropriate legislative liaison office for the shepherding of the
same in Congress;
Formulate a framework for training modules to be administered to
BOC personnel to ensure smooth transition to the enhanced
procedures, processes, and organizational structures, with due
regard to the role of BOC personnel as catalysts in the
achievement of the BOC's development:
Recommend to the DOF Secretary such actions as may be
necessary for the implementation of the proposals above; and
Perform any and all acts as may be necessary and lawful to
successfully implement this EO.

Personnel and Staffing Complement. The CPRO shall be
composed of its organic personnel, as approved by the Department of Budget
and Management (DBM) upon recommendation of the DOF Secretary,
augmented and reinforced by DOF and BOC personnel as well as those
detailed or seconded from other agencies, whether attached to the DOF or not.
In addition, the CPRO, upon approval of the DOF Secretary, may hire or
engage technical consultants to provide necessary support in the performance
of its mandate.

Rules and Regulations. The DOF Secretary is hereby
authorized to promulgate such rules and regulations and prescribe procedures
and processes to enable the CPRO to effectively exercise its powers and
discharge its duties and functions herein provided.

Performance Audit System. The CPRO shall develop a
performance audit system that will monitor and measure actual performance of
CPRO personnel as a basis for rewards and incentives, and punishment for
nonfeasance or malfeasance, subject to existing laws, rules and regulations.
For this purpose, the DOF Secretary, is hereby directed to develop appropriate
performance standards for personnel appointed, designated, or detailed to the
CPRO, and a personnel evaluation system that will advance accountability in

Funding. The funds shall be sourced proportionately from
the savings of the concerned departments, agencies, bureaus and offices as
identified by DBM and subject to the usual government accounting and auditing

rules and regulations. The DOF Secretary shall submit to DBM a proposed
budget to cover the personnel requirements, maintenance and other operating
expense, and capital outlays, if needed.

Separability. If any provision of this Order. is declared
invalid or unconstitutional, the other provisions unaffected shall remain valid
and subsisting.

Repeal. All orders, issuances, proclamations, rules,
regulations, or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with any of the provisions of
this Order are hereby repealed modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately upon
publication in two (2) newspapers of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 2nd day of September ,in the
year of our Lord, Two Thousand and Thirteen.
By the President:
PAQUITO N. OGHOA, JR.
Executive Secretary
